notes.title: Update notes for March 1
notes.notes: Steam version now inherits the changes made for the console versions. Fixed a variety of quality of life bugs and the loading issue that was preventing some players from starting a new game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Draw A Stickman 3: Console release on March 9th
notes.notes:
BIG NEWS,

Get ready to embark on an epic journey with Draw a Stickman 3! We're excited to announce that the game is coming to Microsoft Xbox Series X/S, The PlayStation 4 and 5, and Nintendo Switch. on March 9th. Whether you're snuggled up on the couch or on a road trip, you can enjoy the game on your favorite consoles wherever you go!

In Draw a Stickman 3, you'll draw your own stickman hero and guide them through a fantastical world full of wonder and imagination. Encounter unusual creatures, solve enigmatic puzzles, and unlock new possibilities that lie within the hidden secrets of this mystical land. With the added bonus of playing on your TV, you'll feel like you're part of the adventure like never before! So gather your friends and family, and get ready for a journey full of fun, excitement, and magic!

But that's not all - we're bringing some awesome updates to Draw a Stickman 3 too! Our team has been working tirelessly to make the game even better. With these updates, you can expect a smoother, faster, and more fun gameplay experience. Controls are easier to use, UI responsiveness is improved, and you can dive right into the adventure without any distractions. So get ready to explore the magical world of Draw a Stickman 3 like never before!

So, whether you're a console gamer or a fan of the game on Steam or iOS, Draw a Stickman 3 is the perfect adventure for you. The adventure awaits, dreamers! Are you ready to answer the call and discover the magic that lies within?

notes.notes:
New Save system that remembers your progress in levels. Sleep or exit the game without worry and restore back into the level you left during your last session.
New in game decoration art
Localization Fixes
Quest completion fixes
Fixed a Pathing issue in 1x1

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.7.19205
notes.notes:
New Feature: Using Pages to Unlock Levels! - Brand new feature being rolled out is the ability for players to use their collected pages to unlock levels in the game. Pages are dropped randomly from monsters or puzzles.
Bugs and Fixes
Fixed an Ads Issue
Fixed a Loading issue at start of game
Fixed a Quest being still active after the event.
